description: Run every safety check on a deposit into a Mamo Account: ownership, balance, ETH left for gas, approval, pauses, the earlier MAMO Account, the stocks portfolio's value window, and a dry run of each step on Base. Call this FIRST and pass its `previewId` to `prepare_deposit`. Nothing is signed or sent here.

address.description: The wallet that will sign and send, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

allowThirdParty.description: Set this only after the person has explicitly confirmed, in this conversation, that they mean to fund someone else's Account. The money becomes that owner's the moment it lands. Never set it on the first call.

amount.description: How much to deposit, as a plain decimal string in the Account's own token — "250", "0.05". Not base units, no scientific notation.

owner.description: Only for funding somebody else's Account: the wallet that owns it. Defaults to `address`.

token.description: Stocks only: an Active listed token to deposit instead of USDC.

name: preview_deposit
title: Check a deposit before building it
